name: Borgo28
why: Italian and Portuguese make under an American label — sport shirts, deeply.
origin: Shayne Regan, 2010 — grown out of Studio Regan, the freelance design firm he had set up, and named for an address rather than a founder.
opview: Says it makes in select Italian and Portuguese factories, designed in the United States.

onething.n: verified — 67 styles against 42 knits, by far the deepest category the house makes

notes.linen: 35 of 271 clothing styles are linen-dominant, high for a house this size
notes.ital: Italian and Portuguese make, American design and ownership
notes.shoes: the eight shoes on its site are Woolloomooloo Shoe, not the house's own

cities: No own store established; 70 stockists across 27 states

marks: Only third-party FIBRE brands, every one of them in composition position - nothing else.
